brief: Reads a .zopt optimization file and expands its indexed families into an ordinary stzOptimModel.
detail: A .zopt file declares sets, indexed parameters and variable families, an objective and constraints, with sum and forall over a set. Reading it checks the format and lists every fault in Findings; ToModel then expands the families into plain variables and constraint strings before the model ever sees them, so a file and a hand-built model of the same problem are the same model. ToZopt and Save write the expanded model back as a flat file. Adding a product is editing one list.
receiver:
o1 = new stzOptimFile("")
o1.SetText("zopt: 1" + char(10) + "model: shop" + char(10) + "set Products: chairs, tables" + char(10) + "param profit[Products]: 30, 45" + char(10) + "var make[Products]: 0 .. 100 integer" + char(10) + "maximize: sum profit[p] * make[p] for p in Products" + char(10) + "subject to:" + char(10) + "  forall p in Products: make[p] <= 60")
